items.source: If @TestPropertySource is used as a repeatable annotation, the following special rules apply.
items.translation: 如果将 `@TestPropertySource` 用作 可重复 注解，则适用以下特殊规则。

items.source: Default Properties File Detection
items.translation: 默认属性文件检测

items.source: Test property sources have higher precedence than those loaded from the operating system's environment or Java system properties as well as property sources added by the application declaratively via @PropertySource or programmatically (for example, via an ApplicationContextInitializer or some other means). Thus, test property sources can be used to selectively override properties defined in system and application property sources. Furthermore, inlined properties() have higher precedence than properties loaded from resource locations(). Note, however, that properties registered via @DynamicPropertySource have higher precedence than those loaded via @TestPropertySource.
items.translation: 测试属性源的优先级高于从操作系统环境或 Java 系统属性加载的属性源，以及通过 `@PropertySource` 注解声明添加的属性源，或通过编程方式（例如，通过 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 或其他手段）添加的属性源。因此，可以使用测试属性源选择性地覆盖在系统和应用程序属性源中定义的属性。此外，内联的 `properties()` 的优先级高于从资源 `locations()` 加载的属性。但请注意，通过 `@DynamicPropertySource` 注册的属性具有比通过 `@TestPropertySource` 加载的属性更高的优先级。

items.source: If @TestPropertySource is declared as an empty annotation (i.e., without explicit values for locations() or properties()), an attempt will be made to detect a default properties file relative to the class that declared the annotation. For example, if the annotated test class is com.example.MyTest, the corresponding default properties file is "classpath:com/example/MyTest.properties". If the default cannot be detected, an IllegalStateException will be thrown.
items.translation: 如果声明了 @TestPropertySource 为 空 注解（即没有显式指定 locations() 或 properties() 的值），系统将尝试检测相对于声明该注解的类的 默认 属性文件。例如，如果已添加注解的测试类为 com.example.MyTest，则对应的默认属性文件为 "classpath:com/example/MyTest.properties"。如果无法检测到默认值，将抛出 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Each path will be interpreted as a Spring Resource. A plain path — for example, "test.properties" — will be treated as a classpath resource that is relative to the package in which the test class is defined. A path starting with a slash will be treated as an absolute classpath resource, for example: "/org/example/test.xml". A path which references a URL (for example, a path prefixed with classpath:, file:, http:, etc.) will be loaded using the specified resource protocol.
items.translation: 每个路径都将被解释为 Spring Resource。普通路径——例如，"test.properties"——将被视为相对于测试类所在包中的 classpath 资源。相对路径。以斜杠开头的路径将被视为 绝对 classpath 资源，例如："/org/example/test.xml"。引用 URL 的路径（例如，以 classpath:、file:、http: 等开头）将使用指定的资源协议加载。

items.source: @TestPropertySource is enabled if the configured context loader honors it. Every SmartContextLoader that is a subclass of either AbstractGenericContextLoader or AbstractGenericWebContextLoader provides automatic support for @TestPropertySource, and this includes every SmartContextLoader provided by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: @TestPropertySource 在配置的上下文加载器支持它时才会生效。每个继承自AbstractGenericContextLoader或AbstractGenericWebContextLoader的SmartContextLoader都提供对@TestPropertySource的自动支持，这包括 Spring TestContext Framework 提供的每个SmartContextLoader。

items.source: In the following example, the ApplicationContext for BaseTest will be loaded using only the "base.properties" file as a test property source. In contrast, the ApplicationContext for ExtendedTest will be loaded using the "base.properties" and "extended.properties" files as test property source locations.
items.translation: 在以下示例中，BaseTest 的 ApplicationContext 将仅使用 "base.properties" 文件作为测试属性源加载。相比之下，ExtendedTest 的 ApplicationContext 将使用 "base.properties" 和 "extended.properties" 文件作为测试属性源位置进行加载。

items.source: In the following example, the ApplicationContext for BaseTest will be loaded using only the inlined key1 property. In contrast, the ApplicationContext for ExtendedTest will be loaded using the inlined key1 and key2 properties.
items.translation: 在以下示例中，`BaseTest` 的 `ApplicationContext` 将仅使用内联的 `key1` 属性加载。相比之下，`ExtendedTest` 的 `ApplicationContext` 将使用内联的 `key1` 和 `key2` 属性加载。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with locations(), but it may be used instead of locations().
items.translation: 此属性不能与locations()一起使用，但它可以替代locations()使用。

items.source: WARNING: although properties can be defined using any of the above syntax variants and any number of spaces between the key and the value, it is recommended that you use one syntax variant and consistent spacing within your test suite — for example, consider always using "key = value" instead of "key= value", "key=value", etc. Similarly, if you define inlined properties using text blocks you should consistently use text blocks for inlined properties throughout your test suite. The reason is that the exact strings you provide will be used to determine the key for the context cache. Consequently, to benefit from the context cache you must ensure that you define inlined properties consistently.
items.translation: 警告：虽然属性可以使用上述任何语法变体定义，并且键与值之间可以使用任意数量的空格，但建议在测试套件中使用一种语法变体和一致的间距——例如，考虑始终使用"key = value"，而不是"key= value"、"key=value"等。同样，如果您使用文本块定义内联属性，则应在整个测试套件中一致地使用文本块来定义内联属性。原因是您提供的确切字符串将用于确定上下文缓存的键。因此，为了从上下文缓存中受益，您必须确保一致地定义内联属性。

items.source: This attribute may be used in conjunction with value() or locations().
items.translation: 此属性可与value()或locations()配合使用。

items.source: By default, both traditional and XML-based properties file formats are supported — for example, "classpath:/com/example/test.properties" or "file:/path/to/file.xml". To support a different file format, configure an appropriate PropertySourceFactory.
items.translation: 默认情况下，支持传统的和基于 XML 的属性文件格式——例如 `"classpath:/com/example/test.properties"` 或 `"file:/path/to/file.xml"`。若要支持不同的文件格式，请配置适当的 PropertySourceFactory。

items.source: By default, a factory for standard resource files will be used which supports *.properties and *.xml file formats for Properties.
items.translation: 默认情况下，将使用支持 *.properties 和 *.xml 文件格式的Properties标准资源文件工厂。

items.source: Property placeholders in paths (i.e., ${...}) will be resolved against the Environment.
items.translation: 路径中的属性占位符（即${...}）将针对Environment进行解析。

items.source: WARNING: a pattern such as "classpath*:/config/*.properties" may be effectively equivalent to an explicit enumeration of resource locations such as {"classpath:/config/mail.properties", classpath:/config/order.properties"}; however, the two declarations will result in different keys for the context cache since the pattern cannot be eagerly resolved to concrete locations. Consequently, to benefit from the context cache you must ensure that you consistently use either patterns or explicit enumerations of resource locations within your test suite.
items.translation: 警告：诸如 "classpath*:/config/*.properties" 这样的模式可能与显式枚举资源位置（例如 {"classpath:/config/mail.properties", classpath:/config/order.properties"}）在效果上等效；然而，这两种声明会导致上下文缓存中的键不同，因为模式无法急切解析为具体位置。因此，为了充分利用上下文缓存，您必须确保在测试套件中始终一致地使用模式或显式枚举资源位置。

items.source: The default value is true, which means that a test class will inherit property source locations defined by a superclass or enclosing class. Specifically, the property source locations for a test class will be appended to the list of property source locations defined by a superclass or enclosing class. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the list of test property source locations.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，这意味着测试类将继承由父类或外部类定义的属性源位置。具体而言，测试类的属性源位置将被追加到由父类或外部类定义的属性源位置列表中。因此，子类及内部类有选项可以扩展测试属性源位置列表。

items.source: If inheritLocations is set to false, the property source locations for the test class will shadow and effectively replace any property source locations defined by a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritLocations` 设置为 `false，则测试类的属性源位置将 覆盖 并实际上替换由超类或包含类定义的任何属性源位置。

items.source: The default value is true, which means that a test class will inherit inlined properties defined by a superclass or enclosing class. Specifically, the inlined properties for a test class will be appended to the list of inlined properties defined by a superclass or enclosing class. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the list of inlined test properties.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，这意味着测试类将 继承 由父类或外部类定义的嵌入式属性。具体而言，测试类的嵌入式属性将被追加到由父类或外部类定义的嵌入式属性列表中。因此，子类及内部类可以选择 扩展 嵌入式测试属性列表。

items.source: If inheritProperties is set to false, the inlined properties for the test class will shadow and effectively replace any inlined properties defined by a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritProperties` 设置为 `false，测试类的内联属性将 遮蔽 并实际上替换由超类或外部类定义的任何内联属性。

items.source: Properties loaded from resource locations have lower precedence than inlined properties().
items.translation: 从资源位置加载的属性优先级低于内联的 `properties()`。

items.source: Properties declared via this attribute have higher precedence than properties loaded from resource locations().
items.translation: 通过此属性声明的属性优先级高于从资源 `locations()` 加载的属性。

items.source: Each location will be added to the enclosing Environment as its own property source, in the order declared (or in the order in which resource locations are resolved when location wildcards are used).
items.translation: 每个位置将作为其自身的属性源添加到包围的 `Environment` 中，顺序为声明的顺序（或者在使用位置通配符时解析资源位置的顺序）。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, resource location patterns are also supported — for example, "classpath*:/config/*.properties".
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，也支持资源位置模式——例如 `"classpath*:/config/*.properties"`。

items.source: The supported syntax for key-value pairs is the same as the syntax defined for entries in a Java properties file:
items.translation: 键值对支持的语法与 Java 中定义的属性文件条目语法相同：

items.source: See the class-level Javadoc for a discussion on detection of defaults.
items.translation: 查看类级别的 Javadoc 以了解默认值的检测讨论。

items.source: If not specified, the default character encoding of the JVM will be used.
items.translation: 如果未指定，将使用 JVM 的默认字符编码。

items.source: Inlined properties in the form of key-value pairs that should be added to the Spring Environment before the ApplicationContext is loaded for the test.
items.translation: 以 键值对 形式存在的 内联属性，应在加载测试的 ApplicationContext 之前添加到 Spring Environment。

items.source: Whether test property source locations() from superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 是否应该继承来自父类和包含类的测试属性源locations()。

items.source: Whether inlined test properties() from superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 是否应继承超类和外部类中的内联测试 `properties()`。

items.source: Specify the character encoding for the given resources — for example, "UTF-8".
items.translation: 为给定的资源指定字符编码——例如，"UTF-8"。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations, but caution should be taken if this annotation and @ContextConfiguration are combined on a composed annotation since the locations and inheritLocations attributes of both annotations can lead to ambiguity during the attribute resolution process. Note, however, that ambiguity can be avoided via explicit annotation attribute overrides using @AliasFor.
items.translation: 此注解可用作元注解来创建自定义的组合注解，但如果将此注解与@ContextConfiguration组合在组合注解上使用时需谨慎，因为这两个注解的locations和inheritLocations属性都可能导致属性解析过程中的歧义。不过请注意，可以通过使用@AliasFor显式覆盖注解属性来避免歧义。

items.source: Typically, @TestPropertySource will be used in conjunction with @ContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 通常，@TestPropertySource 会与 @ContextConfiguration 一起使用。

items.source: @TestPropertySource can be used as a repeatable annotation.
items.translation: @TestPropertySource 可以用作一个 可重复 注解。

items.source: All @TestPropertySource annotations at a given level in the test class hierarchy (i.e., directly present or meta-present on a test class) are considered to be local annotations, in contrast to @TestPropertySource annotations that are inherited from a superclass.
items.translation: 给定测试类层次结构中的每个级别，所有 `@TestPropertySource` 注解（即直接存在或元存在于测试类上）均被视为 本地 注解，这与从父类继承的 `@TestPropertySource` 注解形成对比。

items.source: All @TestPropertySource annotations at a given level in the test class hierarchy (i.e., directly present or meta-present on a test class) are considered to be local annotations, in contrast to @TestPropertySource annotations that are inherited from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 给定测试类层级中所有 `@TestPropertySource` 注解（即直接存在或元存在于测试类上）均被视为 本地 注解，这与从父类或包含类继承的 `@TestPropertySource` 注解形成对比。

items.source: All local @TestPropertySource annotations must declare the same value for the inheritLocations flag.
items.translation: 所有本地的 `@TestPropertySource` 注解必须对 `inheritLocations` 标志声明相同的值。

items.source: The inheritLocations flag is not taken into account between local @TestPropertySource annotations. Specifically, the property source locations for one local annotation will be appended to the list of property source locations defined by previous local annotations. This allows a local annotation to extend the list of test property source locations, potentially overriding individual properties.
items.translation: `inheritLocations` 标志在本地 `@TestPropertySource` 注解之间不会被考虑。具体而言，一个本地注解的属性源位置将被追加到先前本地注解定义的属性源位置列表中。这使得本地注解能够扩展测试属性源位置列表，从而可能覆盖单个属性。

items.source: All local @TestPropertySource annotations must declare the same value for the inheritProperties flag.
items.translation: 所有本地的 `@TestPropertySource` 注解必须为 `inheritProperties` 标志声明相同的值。

items.source: The inheritProperties flag is not taken into account between local @TestPropertySource annotations. Specifically, inlined properties for one local annotation will be appended to the list of inlined properties defined by previous local annotations. This allows a local annotation to extend the list of inlined properties, potentially overriding individual properties.
items.translation: `inheritProperties` 标志在本地 `@TestPropertySource` 注解之间不会被考虑。具体而言，一个本地注解的内联属性将追加到先前本地注解定义的内联属性列表中。这使得本地注解能够扩展内联属性列表，并可能覆盖单个属性。
